text:
alex: Hey support — customer on prod seeing repeated 429s and duplicate attempts after retries. Started after we moved to gunicorn --preload + uvicorn workers. Attaching quick repro and logs.

maria: Can you paste the SDK version and a short log snippet? We saw something vaguely similar but thought it was a config issue.

alex: SDK 0.18.5, Python 3.10, Gunicorn 20.1.0, uvicorn 0.20.0. Log excerpt: "WARNING retrying request id=abcd status=429 backoff=0.0" repeated across workers and downstream sees duplicate create calls. Idempotency-Key seems to be set on the initial request but missing on some retries.

ingrid: If you're preloading the client and then forking, RNG state can be duplicated which makes jitter deterministic across workers. Also there was an old bug where headers were shallow-copied and mutated on retry — could drop Idempotency-Key. Need a small repro to be sure.

alex: Minimal repro script below (very small):
```python
import multiprocessing
from redwood import Client

c = Client(api_key="REDACTED", retry_policy={"max_retries": 5, "base": 0.2})

def work(i):
    try:
        c.generate("hello")
    except Exception as e:
        print(i, "err", e)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    multiprocessing.set_start_method('fork')
    procs = [multiprocessing.Process(target=work, args=(i,)) for i in range(4)]
    for p in procs: p.start()
    for p in procs: p.join()
```

alex: Repro steps: run app under gunicorn --preload, hit endpoint with concurrent clients (k6/ab), watch logs — many workers will backoff in lockstep and retries will either omit Idempotency-Key or retry too aggressively, causing downstream 429 loops and duplicate side effects.

tim: Quick mitigation: switch to `multiprocessing.set_start_method('forkserver')` or avoid --preload. Also temporary env var RDW_PRESERVE_RNG=1 we built for one customer preserves RNG state across fork in our branch. That reduced correlated backoffs in our QA.

maria: I reproduced this locally. Root causes: (1) jitter RNG is seeded before fork, so all workers have the same RNG stream; (2) a shallow header copy in retry code meant we reused and then mutated the same headers object, and in one code path we accidentally dropped 'Idempotency-Key' when building the retried request.

maria: I pushed a fix (commit a1b2c3d) that: preserves RNG state across fork, uses deep copies for headers before mutation, and adds a test that simulates gunicorn --preload with multiple processes. Will include a targeted regression test.

alex: Customer asks for a backport to their pinned 0.18.5. Can you provide a wheel/patch they can install? They can't risk waiting for a full release cycle.

maria: I created a cherry-pick branch tags/0.18.5-fix-retries-2025 and built wheels. Install via: `pip install git+https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk@tags/0.18.5-fix-retries-2025#egg=redwood-sdk` — that's a temporary workaround until the stable release.

support-lead: I'll coordinate with CS to inform the customer and include mitigation instructions: avoid --preload or set forkserver, or install the cherry-pick wheel. Also we'll plan an advisory and an RFC for safer default behavior.

alex: Confirmed the cherry-pick wheel fixed the customer's issue in staging. They'll schedule a canary next week and then upgrade to the official release. Thanks. :thumbsup:

dev-bot: release scheduled: v0.18.7 -> 2025-06-17T15:20:00Z (includes RNG/fork fixes, header deep-copy, tests) :rocket:

maria: After release we'll add a note to the SDK docs about forking and recommended start methods and a short KB entry with the minimal repro and mitigations.

alex: Great, closing on our side. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
